summary: Honor explicit community-sync page limits, preserve unlimited mode, and report finite-cap truncation without classifying persisted records as access-skipped.
reason: The community resource path silently rewrote limits to 100, and its cap warning must not erase successful record totals or return a misleading access failure.
validated_outcome: Local tests verify page 101 is persisted, zero means unlimited, and latest-only one-page sync has no truncation notice.
